headline: Kai, markets now price a one-in-three chance the Fed's next move is a hike, and this afternoon's minutes show how seriously to take it.
subline: Fed minutes at 2 p.m., a retail earnings gauntlet led by Target and Lowe's, and a Korean chip rout testing the AI trade while Hormuz stays shut.
asof: Pre-market · as of ~6:40 AM ET · index cells show futures moves vs Tuesday's closes · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Fed minutes at 2 p.m.; September hike odds near 33%
items.sentence: July's minutes land at 2 p.m. ET with CME FedWatch pricing a 32.8% chance of a September rate hike, per Benzinga.

items.title: Target, Lowe's and TJX headline a retail earnings day
items.sentence: Target, Lowe's, TJX, Analog Devices and Estée Lauder all report today, per Schwab, a day after Home Depot's improved sales earned its stock a shrug.

items.title: S&P 500 fell 0.69% Tuesday; Nasdaq-100 worse
items.sentence: The S&P 500 closed at 7,692.62 and the Nasdaq-100 lost 1.68% amid heavy selling in semiconductor and other technology stocks, per Trading Economics.

items.title: KOSPI sinks 5% as the chip selloff goes global
items.sentence: Seoul's index plunged more than 5% with SK Hynix down 9.75% locally even after it announced a $29 billion buyback, per Benzinga.

items.title: Oil holds near $85 with Hormuz shipping stalled
items.sentence: WTI trades at $84.38 with Brent above $91, per Benzinga, after CNBC reported Strait of Hormuz traffic slowing to a crawl around the ceasefire's expiry.

items.title: Trump: no talks with Iran as UAE detects threat
items.sentence: There are 'no talks or conversations going on, or scheduled' with Tehran, Trump said, as the UAE reported detecting a missile threat, per CNN.

items.title: Ukraine hits Moscow with drones; Russian strike kills 10
items.sentence: Ukraine aimed a drone blitz at Moscow overnight while Russian missiles killed 10 people in a Ukrainian village, per the Washington Times.

items.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump's Carroll appeal
items.sentence: The court declined to rehear Trump's challenge to the $5 million E. Jean Carroll verdict, its second denial in the case, per CBS News.

items.title: Kushner, Netanyahu agree on Gaza demilitarization overseer
items.sentence: After marathon meetings, Kushner and Netanyahu agreed a U.S. general should oversee Hamas's demilitarization under the Gaza plan, per NBC News.

items.title: Judge blocks FBI headquarters move to Washington
items.sentence: A federal judge blocked the administration's plan to relocate FBI headquarters, finding prior Maryland facility approvals were unlawfully discarded, per AP via Just Security.

items.title: Stripe buys OpenRouter for more than $7 billion
items.sentence: Stripe finalized its acquisition of the AI model-routing gateway for over $7 billion, folding model selection into payments infrastructure, per Bloomberg.

items.title: Unitree soars 629% in Shanghai trading debut
items.sentence: The humanoid-robot maker surged 629% on its first day to a roughly $66 billion valuation, per the South China Morning Post.

items.title: Beijing lets ByteDance, Tencent import Nvidia H200s
items.sentence: China is reportedly allowing ByteDance and Tencent to import 10,000 H200 chips apiece, an easing of Beijing's own curbs, per Engadget.

items.title: Anthropic passes $11.5 billion in quarterly revenue
items.sentence: Anthropic's second-quarter revenue surged past $11.5 billion, per Fortune, with the Journal reporting OpenAI's growth now lags its rival's.

items.title: Pennsylvania reins in AI data-center buildout
items.sentence: Gov. Shapiro signed an executive order giving local communities more control over new AI data-center development in Pennsylvania, per the governor's office.
